candidates.description: This vector represents Thai words, suffixes, and common functional morphemes frequently associated with processes, acts, or nominalizations, often incorporating the root morpheme "การ" (kan).
This feature represents common morphological suffixes and linguistic endings found across various medical, scientific, and foreign terms.
This feature vector activates on Thai script characters and sub-word tokens.
These tokens represent character sequences associated with the Thai script and phonetic transliteration subwords.
This vector represents the alphanumeric characters 'T' and 'B' along with various Thai script characters.
This vector represents the string fragment and prefix "per" across various languages, transliterations, and text encodings.
This feature vector activates strongly on common Thai script characters, subwords, and words.
This feature vector activates on medical terminology and health-related concepts across multiple languages.
This feature vector activates strongly on unrelated subword tokens and noise across multiple languages.
This feature vector activates on Thai script characters, specific linguistic sub-tokens, and alphanumeric noise artifacts.
